newsitem.title: BULGARIA: Bulgaria c-bank supports lev at 226 to dollar.
newsitem.headline: Bulgaria c-bank supports lev at 226 to dollar.

text.p: Bulgarian central bank sold dollars on the domestic interbank market at opening, supporting the lev around 226 per dollar at the opening of the interbank market, firmer than 226.50/227.50 at Monday's close, dealers said.
"The central bank has been selling dollars at around 226 levs since the start of the trade," one dealer said.
Foreign currency demand however was low and foreign currency sales by the central bank were large enough to meet it for the time being, dealers said.
Central bank officials were not immediately available for comment.
By 1015 local time (0715 GMT) the dollar was bid at 224.00/05 levs and was offered at 226.00/15.
If no large dollar bids emerge and the central bank persists in its foreign currency sales the lev might strengthen further by the end of the day, dealers said.
The central bank has been actively selling dollars to commercial banks since Friday when the lev slumped to 237-238 to the dollar on a foreign currency buying rush.
The lev closed at 222-223 per dollar a week ago. -- Anastas Petrov, Sofia Newsroom, 359-2-84561
